target.title: fix(browser): reject loose click coordinate numbers when normalizing actions
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Browser action requests could accept loose coordinate numbers for `clickCoords`, such as hexadecimal or exponent-form strings, when users or tools submit direct coordinate clicks through the browser `/act` workflow.

## Why This Change Was Made

`clickCoords` now uses one browser-owned decimal-only finite coordinate parser from both the CLI and the `/act` route before dispatch, matching the Browser CLI contract that allows fractional CSS-pixel coordinates while rejecting non-decimal numeric syntax. This is an owner-local browser route/CLI normalization fix only; it does not add config, compatibility aliases, or provider behavior.

## User Impact

Browser action callers get consistent validation for coordinate clicks: decimal and fractional coordinates continue to work, while hexadecimal and exponent-form strings are rejected before malformed coordinate clicks are dispatched.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: Browser `/act` route normalization and the Browser CLI now share one decimal-only `clickCoords` parser, preserve decimal/fractional coordinates, reject loose numeric strings, and avoid dispatching malformed coordinate clicks.
- Current PR head: `6de51742e99864f83357adbc7f738b1158fe09de`; matching proof tree: `2a9fe51c86ff23a89a47addba253a4a6928d53d2`.
- Conflict/parser repair: merged current `main` into the PR branch, resolved the Browser route overlap, and moved the decimal coordinate grammar into `extensions/browser/src/browser/click-coordinate.ts` so `extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/agent.act.normalize.ts` and `extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/register.element.ts` share the same parser.
- Current-head checks:
  - GitHub `Real behavior proof` passed on the current head: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29161445172/job/86567099365.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/agent.act.normalize.test.ts extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/register.element.test.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/server.agent-contract-core.test.ts --testNamePattern "clickCoords|coordinate|click-coords|numeric fields"` passed with 11 tests passing and 37 skipped.
  - `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
  - `python .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Earlier real Browser `/act` setup proof for this behavior path: a temporary no-repo-change proof script launched a fresh headless Chrome profile with remote debugging, started the product Browser control routes through `registerBrowserRoutes` and `createBrowserRouteContext`, opened a local HTML page, and posted directly to the real `/act` HTTP route. The successful fractional request went through Playwright and incremented the page's click counter; the rejected hexadecimal and exponent requests returned before dispatch, leaving the counter unchanged.

```text
Browser /act real setup proof (head 31a4da266410c811419e3d2d2089f5da1c25d28c; behavior preserved by the current-head shared-parser repair above)
Chrome CDP: http://127.0.0.1:65204 (temporary headless Chrome profile)
Browser control: http://127.0.0.1:65206
Test page: http://127.0.0.1:65205/proof
Opened targetId: 31A5A133CA7CFBCE07B9F4B47893361B
fractional clickCoords status/body: 200 {"ok":true,"targetId":"31A5A133CA7CFBCE07B9F4B47893361B","url":"http://127.0.0.1:65205/proof"}
click state after fractional: 200 {"ok":true,"targetId":"31A5A133CA7CFBCE07B9F4B47893361B","url":"http://127.0.0.1:65205/proof","result":{"clicks":1,"last":{"x":42,"y":44,"target":"target"}}}
hex clickCoords status/body: 400 {"error":"clickCoords requires non-negative x and y","code":"ACT_INVALID_REQUEST"}
exponent clickCoords status/body: 400 {"error":"clickCoords requires non-negative x and y","code":"ACT_INVALID_REQUEST"}
click state after rejected inputs: 200 {"ok":true,"targetId":"31A5A133CA7CFBCE07B9F4B47893361B","url":"http://127.0.0.1:65205/proof","result":{"clicks":1}}
```

- Observed result: normalization accepts decimal fractional strings such as `x: "10.5", y: ".25"`; the CLI rejects non-decimal coordinate arguments before sending `/act`; and `/act` returns `ACT_INVALID_REQUEST` with `clickCoords requires non-negative x and y` for negative, hexadecimal, and exponent-form coordinate inputs before malformed clicks are dispatched.
